limits.en: Post one clip per day, 3-day media storage, watermarked animated captions, single 9:16 aspect ratio, no credit card required.

keyLimits.en: 3 AI B-Roll clips/month, 3 stock clips/month, 20 AI voiceovers/day, watermark-free exports for 30 days, 29-day media storage.
Up to 30GB video files, 100GB fixed storage, unlimited stock B-roll, 50 AI image clips/day, team workspace for 2-4 users, scheduler for 6 platforms.
Unlimited storage and team members, dedicated processing queue, custom branding, priority support, full API access.

cautions.en: Free plan limits exports to a single daily post with a 3-day storage expiration, and adds watermarked animated captions, which is a hard constraint for regular use.

capabilities.en: AI-driven detection of clip-worthy moments in long-form video using spoken words, visual objects, sound and emotion analysis.
Automatic reframing, virality scoring, and AI B-roll/voiceover generation for short-form output.
Built-in social scheduler posting to up to 6 platforms (YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram and others) on paid plans.

limitations.en: Free tier caps output to one clip per day and expires stored media after 3 days.
AI B-roll, stock clips and voiceovers are metered per month/day even on paid tiers below Business, requiring an upgrade for heavier use.

reason.en: Video/audio editor with AI clipping and repurposing features aimed at content creators.
Popular free/low-cost video editor with short-form clipping and auto-captioning tools.
AI short-form video generation tool targeting the same creator repurposing use case.
